experiments.name: Regime gate
experiments.problem: the system loses in low-predictability regimes
experiments.hypothesis: standing down when trailing market accuracy < floor improves realized EV
experiments.mechanism: stand down when the market itself is unpredictable

mechanism_check.note: Δ on regime<floor windows +19.5c (n=52) vs +0.0c on healthy windows — the gate earns exactly where it claims to

experiments.name: EV-ranked leader

tombstones.root_cause: forecast at T−3 min — value not monetizable
tombstones.lesson: accuracy without decision-time monetizability is not economic skill
classification recall alone is not skill

tombstones.looked_good: paying less than the ask sounds free
tombstones.failed: −4.7c/$1 paired; win-given-fill falls 68%→47% with bid depth (adverse selection measured)
tombstones.root_cause: a resting bid fills preferentially when the market has just repriced the call down (Glosten–Milgrom)
tombstones.lesson: passive entry alone does not repair execution; M11+M8 lives on only as a conditional-effect study

tombstones.looked_good: Herbster–Warmuth tracking beats frozen winners in theory; leader churn was 38%
tombstones.failed: M3 −2.2c standalone; M3+M8 −7.1c vs M8 alone (P(inc>0)=6%) — it actively interfered with the regime gate
tombstones.lesson: stabilizing the leader overrode exactly the arm switches the regime filter needed
tombstones.do_not_revisit_unless: a selection objective change (M12 redesign) reopens the question

tombstones.failed: p=0.60 under multiplicity — 24 hours searched, ~2 false positives expected, 2 found
tombstones.lesson: a plausible slice is not a pre-registered hypothesis
